subject.title: fix: deliver completed replies when post-turn compaction fails

question: Should merge require a new exact-head Matrix or equivalent channel proof after commits 201b770c, 198aba58, and cbe44262 changed the runtime path?
rationale: The prior live proof is strong but does not execute the current media-recovery and persisted-marker prerequisite behavior, while these session and delivery invariants can cause loss or duplication if wrong.

options.title: Require Exact-Head Proof
options.body: Rebase or refresh the head, then rerun redacted real channel proof covering compaction-timeout delivery and recovery-marker cleanup, preferably including media and restart recovery.

options.title: Accept Prior Proof
options.body: Treat the prior Matrix run plus focused current-head tests as sufficient because the subsequent commits narrow or preserve the intended invariants.

recommendation.title: Require Exact-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the head, then rerun redacted real channel proof covering compaction-timeout delivery and recovery-marker cleanup, preferably including media and restart recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assignee and authored all runtime changes made after the accepted proof.
